def flop_count(model: nn.Module, inputs: Tuple[Any, ...], supported_ops:
    Optional[Dict[str, Handle]]=None) ->Tuple[DefaultDict[str, float],
    Counter[str]]:
    flop_counter = FlopCountAnalysis(model, inputs)
    if supported_ops is not None:
        flop_counter.set_op_handle(**supported_ops)
    flop_counter.unsupported_ops_warnings(False)
    flop_counter.uncalled_modules_warnings(False)
    by_operator = flop_counter.by_operator()
    flop_dict: DefaultDict[str, float] = defaultdict(float)
    for op, count in by_operator.items():
        flop_dict[op] = count / 1e9
    skipped_ops = flop_counter.unsupported_ops()
    return flop_dict, skipped_ops
